title: Happy Mobs
description: Adds Happy Mobs to the game with a resource pack
body:
This Resource Pack adds Happy Mobs To the game! This changes the pig, creeper warden and more (more coming soon)! [My youtube channel (early access builds avalible there too!)](https://www.youtube.com/@ItsDuckRBLX) 
How to download: 
1. Install the resource pack
2. drag the .zip file to your minecraft Resource Pack folder
3. make sure it is applied in minecraft
